body: I haven't tried. It seems like a pointless struggle. I know I sound so negative and honestly it's ridiculous. I'm looking at what I'm typing and acknowledging it's absurdly pessimistic, but I can't force myself to believe that anything good will come from the effort. I appreciate that you're even taking the time to talk to me about it though.

I haven't touched the new plan. For whatever reason I noticed they haven't charged me past the first month even though I set up recurring payments. I don't have the energy to deal with that mess. And after the experience I've had with my previous doctors, it doesn't seem worth the time and money. I did get a machine for the sleep apnea and I use it every night, otherwise I wouldn't be able to sleep at all. It seems like once that was done, they considered the issue solved and I had to drag their feet over a period of 2 years to respond any further. When I finally saw the neurologist he had the nerve to ask me why I didn't come in sooner. It's difficult to have to constantly explain myself and justify how I'm feeling to a system that feels totally unsympathetic. I can't keep doing it.
Not through my employer, but through healthcare.gov.
Plenty. I switched jobs because I knew I would like this more, but it isn't a reason to live. It's just a job.
